home.intro: Three steps to get your business posting on its own. Start with the first one.

profile.title: Tell PostingDay who you are
profile.desc: Name, industry, tone and networks. This is how the AI writes like you.

media.title: Upload photos and videos of your business
media.desc: At least 5. From the computer or straight from your phone with a QR code.

plan.title: Create your first post
plan.desc: Pick a format, check the preview and let PostingDay do the rest.

roadmap: Sprint 2 · Monthly plan, hook ideas, captions and image posts
Sprint 3 · Reels from your photos and clips: templates, music, voice and captions
Sprint 4 · Scheduled publishing to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube

profile.title: My business
profile.subtitle: Everything you write here feeds every post the AI writes. Be specific.

fields.name: Business name
fields.description: What you do and for whom
fields.descriptionHint: E.g.: Neighborhood hardware store, 20 years in business. Tools, paint and plumbing for homeowners and contractors.
fields.audienceHint: E.g.: Men and women 30–60 who fix up their house on weekends.
fields.starProducts: Star products or services (one per line)
fields.neverSayHint: E.g.: never promise free shipping, never mention competitors.

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Real photos and videos of your business. Posts and reels are built from these.
library.empty: Nothing here yet. Import photos of your store, your products or your team.
library.noteHint: E.g.: ceramic pan, counter photo, arrived in October
library.ffmpegMissing: FFmpeg was not found: previews and video details won't be generated.

ai.title: Artificial intelligence
ai.statusMock: No key: the app uses example texts so you can try everything.
ai.keyHint: Stored only on this computer. Get it at console.anthropic.com (not included in the Claude subscription).
ai.saved: Key saved. The next generation will use the AI.
ai.imageKeyHint: To generate product photos when you have no image. Get it at platform.openai.com.
ai.imageStatusMock: No image key: example cards are used instead of generated photos.

modes.auto: Automatic (Claude if key, else Ollama, else example)

imageModes.auto: Automatic (OpenAI if key, else built-in engine, else local server, else example)
imageModes.local: External local server (Draw Things / Stable Diffusion WebUI)

ai.statusOllama: Texts by the local AI: Ollama, model {{model}}.
ai.ollamaNone: Ollama has no models installed. In Terminal: ollama pull qwen3:8b
ai.ollamaOff: Ollama is not responding. Open it or install it from ollama.com.
ai.imageStatusLocal: Images from your local generator at {{url}}.
ai.localOff: No local generator detected. Free on Mac: install Draw Things (App Store), download a model (e.g. FLUX.1 schnell) and enable “API Server” in its settings (port 7860).
ai.imageStatusEngine: Images by the built-in local engine ({{model}}), on your Mac and free.
ai.engineUnsupported: Mac with Apple Silicon only for now.
ai.engineNotInstalled: Not installed. Downloads ~9 GB (binary and model, MIT and Apache licenses) into PostingDay's data folder. Can be paused and resumed.
ai.engineInstalled: Installed. Starts on its own when you generate the first image.

create.title: What do you want to post?
create.subtitle: Pick a format. Previews already use your colors, your name and your photos.

how.title: How it works
how.step1: You pick the format (product, offer, tip…).
how.step2: PostingDay writes the text and builds the image or reel.
how.step3: You check it, approve with one click, and it gets published.

create.noPhotos: Without photos in the library, previews use a background in your color. Import photos to see them with your business.

detail.step1: Pick the photo(s) below (or record what we ask for).
detail.step2: PostingDay writes the text in your tone and builds the design.
detail.step3: Check the preview, tweak anything, approve.
detail.previewNote: Example with your data. The final text is written by the AI.
detail.aiMock: Trial mode: texts are examples. Add your Anthropic key in Settings so the AI writes them.
detail.topicPlaceholder: E.g.: Phillips screwdriver, kids haircut, washable paint 1 gal
detail.topicHint: The texts will be about this. No photo? Generate an image with the button.
detail.imageMock: No image engine: an example card is created. Install the free local engine in Settings or add your OpenAI key.
detail.aiOllama: Texts are written by the local AI ({{model}}), free and without leaving your Mac.
detail.imageLocal: Images from your local generator (Draw Things / Stable Diffusion).
detail.imageEngine: Images by the built-in local engine ({{model}}), free and on your Mac. The first one takes ~1 min to warm up.

star_product.name: Star product
star_product.desc: Show one product and why people buy it.
star_product.long: The piece that sells most: a good photo, one clear benefit and a call to action. Perfect for a different product every week.

weekly_offer.name: Weekly offer
weekly_offer.long: Price, condition and until when. Offers with a deadline bring more visits than open-ended ones.

new_arrival.name: Just arrived
new_arrival.long: New stock is a reason to come back. One photo of the new product and a line that invites people in.

before_after.name: Before and after
before_after.desc: The change you deliver, in two photos.
before_after.long: Works for repairs, renovations, cleaning, haircuts and anything visible. Two photos from the same angle.

how_to.name: How to use it
how_to.desc: A quick tip from the expert.
how_to.long: The owner records three short clips with the phone following our shot list; PostingDay joins them and adds voice and captions.

sample.headline: 3 mistakes with {{product}}
sample.sub: And how to avoid them in 20 seconds

faq.name: Frequent question
faq.long: “Do you deliver?”, “Open on Sundays?”. Every question you get at the counter is a post.

sample.headline: Do you deliver?
sample.sub: Yes: orders before 2 pm arrive the same day

behind_scenes.name: Behind the scenes
behind_scenes.desc: Your team and how you work.
behind_scenes.long: People buy from people. Two clips of how you prepare, organize or serve, and one honest line.

sample.headline: A day at {{business}}
sample.sub: What you don't see from the counter

testimonial.name: Testimonial
testimonial.long: A real customer quote (with permission) and their photo or the product's. The cheapest social proof there is.

sample.headline: “Super fast service and the product arrived perfect.”

pieces.title: Posts
pieces.subtitle: Everything you have generated: drafts and approved.
pieces.empty: Nothing generated yet. Go to Create, pick a format and press Generate.
pieces.confirmDelete: Delete this post? This cannot be undone.

piece.captionHint: Change anything you like: once approved, it is published as is.
piece.approvedNote: Approved. In sprint 4 you will schedule it and it will publish on its own.
piece.mockNote: Example texts (no AI). Edit them by hand or add your key in Settings.
piece.claudeNote: Texts written by the AI in your business tone. Edit anything you like.
piece.ollamaNote: Texts written by the local AI (Ollama) in your business tone. Edit anything you like.

capture.title: Upload from phone
capture.subtitle: No accounts, no cloud: your phone sends photos to this laptop over Wi-Fi.
capture.urlLabel: or type this address in the phone browser
capture.step1: Connect the phone to the same Wi-Fi as this laptop.
capture.step2: Open the phone camera, point it at the QR code and tap the link.
capture.step3: Take photos or record clips. They show up here on their own.
capture.waiting: Waiting for photos from the phone…
capture.firewall: If macOS asks whether PostingDay may accept incoming connections, answer “Allow”. Keep this window open while sending.
